note: Narration for «Правило №6». at = where the line starts in the short (s), or anchor = the word that lands on a beat; by = the latest it may end; sub = word-by-word subtitles in groups of so many words (lines with no lettering of their own). The silence and the hit 10–12.9 s, the А gag 18.35–19.3 s and the loop seam stay free of voice.

lines.text: Они идут на запах и видят только тени.
Ведь тень у кота — как у тигра.
